parameters.prompt: The exact spider-bodied demon lady in the reference casts ONE ground curse in place. From the resting pose she raises both hands up to her chest with the palms together, then thrusts both open palms down and forward toward the ground in front of her, the upper body bending forward and the spider legs bracing wide, holds this pressing pose for a moment, then straightens and calmly returns to the exact original pose and holds it. The spider legs stay planted and do not walk. She stays at the same spot and size and does not move across the frame. Exactly two human arms and eight spider legs. Fixed camera, fixed size, pure uniform bright green #00FF00 background. The whole character stays inside the frame with clear margins at all times. Keep the same three-quarter left view, face, hair, upper clothing, spider body and leg colours. No webs, walking, turning, jumping, extra limbs, weapon, glow, energy, magic effects, smoke, mist, dust, rocks, cracks, particles, shadow or text. Motion beats: gather the hands over the first second and a half, thrust down around two seconds and hold to three seconds, then recover and hold the original pose.
